title: Intern Civil Design Engineer
content_text:
INTERN CIVIL DESIGN ENGINEER at Martens & Associates, Hornsby NSW. 0k+ based on experience and skills. 6 month full time internship; successful interns may continue full time while finalising studies.
Exposure to flood assessments, property and development drainage, site water quality/quantity/drainage solutions, civil design of earthworks, roads, regrading.
ESSENTIAL: Graduated from or enrolled in the later part of an engineering degree; good English communication; motivated team player; able to work in a civil design team.
FAVOURABLE: Civil 3D / 12d; hydraulic models; GIS; AutoCAD/BricsCAD; scripting; prior multidisciplinary consultancy land development.
RESIDENCY REQUIREMENTS: All candidates considered including international students.
How to apply: Employment Hero post preferred, or email careers@martens.com.au with [InternCivil260805] and full name in subject; cover letter attn Soroush Ziaee, resume, transcripts.
Contacts named on advert: Ramin Kolahdoozha / Soroush Ziaee (drafter sister ad); intern attn Soroush Ziaee.
apply_instructions: Apply on Employment Hero post, or email careers@martens.com.au with subject [InternCivil260805] and your full name; attach cover letter (attn Soroush Ziaee), resume and transcripts.
